---
name: Full chapter revision template
about: An itemized issue for editing one chapter in a guide. Please provide sufficient
  detail that the revisions can be addressed by a member of the editing team.
title: "[Chapter revision]"
labels: Chapter revision
assignees: ''

---

**What guide are you proposing revisions for?**
[ ] EML Best Practices guide
[ ] Dataset Design For Special Cases
[ ] Domain Specific Guides

**What chapter are you proposing a revision to?**
Please identify the chapter name and filename (e.g. chapter.qmd) to be edited.

**Describe the high-level revisions you would like to propose.**
Briefly describe the changes you are proposing at a high level for this chapter. This might include summarizing new content needed, sections to remove, reorganization of existing content/sections, wording changes, conceptual changes, etc.  

**Describe specific content that should be added.**
Describe content that needs to be added to the chapter, and (briefly) why. Also propose a location for the addition (existing section, new section header, etc.). If you have suggested text, include it in quotes.

**Describe specific content that can be deleted.**
Describe what content should be deleted, and (briefly) why. Please identify the content by section header or line numbers, and itemize multiple proposed changes in a bulleted list.

**Describe any necessary revisions to existing content.**
Identify and describe any proposed changes to existing chapter content. Please identify the content by section header or line numbers, and itemize multiple proposed changes in a bulleted list. Proposed changes can be specific or general, and if you have suggested text, include it in quotes.

**Describe any reorganization needed.**
Briefly describe how to move or reorganize content within the chapter. Please identify the content by section header or line numbers, and itemize multiple proposed changes in a bulleted list.
